With the end of quarter deadline at midnight tonight, you’re probably getting a deluge of emails asking for your hard-earned dollars (I know I am!). So, I wanted to explain real quick why contributions from grassroots supporters like you are so important. | Hey friend. With the end of quarter deadline at _**midnight tonight**_ , you’re probably getting a deluge of emails asking for your hard-earned dollars (I know I am!). So, I wanted to explain real quick why [contributions from grassroots supporters like you](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36742352/309047880/-847830491?refcode=fl_email_fr_20210930eoq4_EG_all_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDI3NGM0Ny1mNTIxLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tk3uxDIGkEb6bhe1UlPkVr8Ouq4YpegMq-sUoM8jKwI=) are so important. Your donations help in a multitude of ways, but it really comes down to three main things:
* **Run outreach programs all over the 15th District.** Right now, that means running ads to reach voters wherever they’re online, as well as laying groundwork for getting out into the community. Down the road, we’ll shift those resources into persuasion and Get Out the Vote efforts to help voters register and cast their ballot while making the case for why we need a fresh voice in Congress (It’s me! Just imagine my voice fighting for you and your families, sweet dulcet tones and all).

* **Close the gap between our campaign and Scott Franklin’s dark money machine.** We simply don’t have the deep-pocketed corporate backing that Franklin’s campaign does (and I’m proud of that!). By relying on $5, $10, or $50 at a time from grassroots supporters, we can close that gap and put ourselves in a position to go toe-to-toe against our corporate-backed opponent. It makes us the underdog here, but what’s the fun in being the favorite?

* **Demonstrate support from a wide-ranging, diverse foundation of supporters.** People invest in causes they believe in. The power of grassroots donations is that they allow people from every kind of background you can imagine to show that they care, and that they believe in a better way forward for this district, for Florida, and for our country. That’s why we’ve set this goal of 500 grassroots donations, instead of a total amount raised: Even if you give just a dollar, you’re proving that this campaign has a broad foundation of supporters that will fuel us all the way to the finish line next November.

clean_body: | = | | I’ll be honest, Peter. This race is going to be a tough one. I am a Democrat running against a right-wing radical who helped incite an insurrection -- but I have a plan to defeat Madison Cawthorn and that plan involves you. = | | | = | | = So exactly how do we plan on defeating Madison Cawthorn? It’s a great question and one I’ve been getting a lot out on the campaign trail. I get it. I’m not exactly your typical politician and the last time a Democrat won NC-11 was 2010. Not to mention, Cawthorn has the backing of Donald Trump and his right-wing donor network. But it’s clear that Cawthorn doesn’t represent who we are in WNC and we deserve better from our leaders. We have the power to replace Cawthorn and bring unity, leadership, and the truth back to NC-11. Harnessing that power requires that we build the largest grassroots organizing campaign WNC has ever seen, which will be the foundation of the largest voter turnout operation we’ve seen. It means organizing early, often, and everywhere. That’s why I’m out there knocking doors and organizing from parking lots to front porches. I'm connecting with folks across the district and talking with them about issues from expanding rural broadband, to the COVID-19 pandemic, to how we bring jobs to the region that pay a dignified wage. We win by holding Cawthorn accountable for his extremism and making sure people in WNC have access to the truth, not disinformation. From his dangerous rhetoric to voting against the American Rescue Plan, Cawthorn prioritizes his own extreme political agenda over his actual job of representing WNC. And people are noticing. He’s losing support, including from some of the very people who worked hard to elect him in 2020. To do this, we need resources to ensure we can execute our strategic priorities on a daily basis, not delay key steps because we can't afford them yet. name: Peter Franchot
subject: I’m asking for your help
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/logo.png]Dear Peter,
My end-of-month fundraising deadline for September is approaching in just a few hours. Right now, I wanted to write to you about how we’re building a people-powered movement to transform Maryland in 2022 -- but if you don’t have the time to read my full message, I’d greatly appreciate if you could chip in whatever you can spare before our 11:59 PM deadline tonight to help us raise the $5,000 we need to hit our critical September fundraising goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/september2021eom?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/september2021eom?amount=20.22]2022 will be a historic year for Maryland. Our working families and small businesses have been financially decimated by this once-in-a-generation crisis, and it will be up to the next Governor to oversee our economic recovery.
I don’t think it’s enough that we return to a status quo that has left behind far too many of our friends, family and neighbors. Hundreds of thousands of Marylanders still live without healthcare coverage. Our transportation infrastructure is in dire need of a 21st century upgrade. And leaders still aren’t taking the critical steps that we need to prevent the most catastrophic outcomes of climate change.
If I’m blessed to be your next Governor, I’m going to take the bold action needed to rise to the urgency of this historic moment. I’m going to make sure that no family has to choose between life-saving healthcare versus putting food on the table. I’ll kickstart our economic growth by building statewide transit that connects all corners of our state. And on Day One, I’ll put Maryland on track to becoming the first net zero state in the nation and a national leader in renewable energy.
We have a real shot at securing a better and stronger future for ALL of Maryland’s communities in 2022, but we can’t do it without your support. Will you help me meet my fundraising goal for September by chipping in whatever you can before 11:59 PM tonight? We’re only $5,000 away from hitting our goal, and a groundswell of grassroots donations will easily get us there.

This is a highly competitive election that is shaping up to be the most expensive in our state’s history, and it’s going to take the full support of our people-powered grassroots movement to take this campaign to the finish line.
Thank you,

name: Amanda Edwards
subject: Thank You
body:
I would like to take this opportunity to thank...
| | | |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| |
---
Friends, I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for your thoughts, prayers and condolences extended due to my mother, Isabella Dorian Edwards, passing away. My family has been touched by the messages we have received and by the many meals you have provided. She was an anchor for our family, church, and community, and she will be greatly missed. Your sympathy and support have helped to provide some much-needed comfort during this difficult time. We will always remember her smile, selflessness, compassion, service and love. A link to her obituary may be found [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00180yZx2RN61Pn7rjgkpdvNqIJvusqjUrpk_w4QKKICXzJc0Y_1FDA9vZZ4BHa91c7juzQGkV_qsMTGdM3VxFC9ssmlEHc93m4jhpIYE3td5dqLQbwFataBHEKmS9rR29xWC4XZ6OcvSpHYbFMuYZt_kOXRvanlLkmy0wJT7k8HOE5D6THaAW-XJoWItob4O9RQsyYeacwR2P4kWYYw4kU_KXBk_Lf9JLaWbZHrSYMSB7c7x94j6K68kcwLdzrQn0W&c=CxwJi5eoc4y0dBVC5aY-g-AyfymiejzDJzLnxw5fg4C9j-1FJJ5PgQ==&ch=7RMlCJYP8-YIeXuan7vRAt41706q4Y_8VMbePvq_YXfY1IPCk44YxQ==). Many thanks to those who have sent flowers or made contributions to the following entities in her honor: Triple Negative Breast Cancer Foundation to support the research of Triple Negative Breast Cancer; SurviveHer to support "mammogrants" for those in need of support to obtain mammograms; Breast Cancer Research Foundation to support cancer research; Sister's Network to provide support to Black Women who are living with or who have survived breast cancer. Thank you again.
---

---

---
Best Wishes,
Amanda K. Edwards

| | Friend,

Many of you responded to our last-minute call for support of our End-of-Quarter push, _but many of you didn't see our message._

I'm sending one last email as a final call for our push to wrap up the 3rd Quarter with strong support. Without your support, Dan Newhouse will think we are losing momentum and we might end up with a crowded field of candidates as we had in the Governor's race.
I don't want that and I know you don't either.
As I mentioned in yesterday's email, I’ve set a HUGE goal of raising another **$25,000 in our final two days**. Your support is so vital to our success and you've never let us down in the past. Yesterday, we raised about half of what we need and I'm counting on you to help us raise the other half so we can crush our goal.

[**_Please contribute ANY AMOUNT IMMEDIATELY to CRUSH our End-of-Quarter fundraising goal_**](https://app.getresponse.com/click.html?x=a62b&lc=SZzNYP&mc=rr&s=Bttw6dS&u=Q96gS&z=EIS7FWL&)** _._**

And that’s yours.

body:
By now, I’m sure you're as furious as I am with the White House’s absurd and illegal COVID vaccine mandate. The federal
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0fjvbtrmc2k39okmh6ktk0fgd5lvut91r4v56eo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqn4sdic9p6acjlm4rbeollmmp79phkcsqm6cbhctij7chm6pg7epr26koreptnmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3imdj38o5jc3jr5d366jgb4ohme8gq48bi4bh28or6cpg64p32c5h649fg)
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0c4qsftvv6247lei736ut1objjdjb6s90pa8t10_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) Fellow American, By now, I’m sure you're as furious as I am with the White House’s absurd and illegal COVID vaccine mandate. The federal government has **_NO POWER_** to get involved in your medical decisions. **__PERIOD_!_** But for millions of college students in America today, it’s not just the federal government they have to worry about. **In fact, more than 2,500 colleges and universities are __FORCING__ students to get the COVID vaccine... __DEMANDING__ that they publicly share their medical history... and __BANNING__ them from school if they don’t comply!** My friend, this is the pattern for vaccine mandates across America--including Joe Biden’s. And if we don’t stand up against it now, there’s no telling how aggressive the federal government will get in their quest to force this vaccine on you and me whether we want it or not. [**_That’s why Turning Point USA and our army of 400,000 student activists are leading the battle against forced COVID vaccines on campus. Will you stand with these students today by signing TPUSA’s National Open Letter Against Forced COVID Vaccinations?_**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrhjffhcp7llm7sfko10cvdt0ouiffbdmha139io_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z11osj153brisls8iiqg8neg8ldbndibi4lb5aro_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) To ensure that students are ready to win the fight for freedom against radical college administrations, we’ve launched a **“NO FORCED VAX”** campaign and created engaging and educational activism kits that we’re shipping out to students every week. [**Your signature right now will help complement that effort by showing these Leftist university administrators just how many Real Americans are opposed to their radical policies.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpmmb42bftfk1g1g363ftrlq35cqk9p700o20mkg_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) This move by the universities is not about vaccines **_AT ALL_**. It’s about freedom, choice, information, and constitutional rights. Young and healthy students —the least affected by the disease — must be free to decide what is best for them alongside their doctors... not college administrators or bureaucrats. The same goes for all Americans, but the Biden administration has watched what these universities have been able to get away with--and put their policies on steroids. As I write this email, thousands of students have been denied reentry to their campuses until they can show proof of vaccination. One student at Rutgers was even locked out of his __ONLINE__ college classes until he takes the vaccine! **If we let these schools exercise this kind of power over their students, I hate to see what the White House comes up with next!** We must win this campus battle right now, or we’ll be fighting it on our own doorsteps. [**Please partner with TPUSA _NOW_ in the fight against forced COVID vaccinations! With your signature on the National Open Letter today, you’ll help turn up the heat on these radical universities and stand with conservative students across America as they defend their freedom.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zagkqplj1ngbtlq6k603nbibn9cre4fp0s2u4hv0_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) [**Stop Forced Vaccination!**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj00flirerjieuiaereqgmm8qoqsu2o211tfrtoo_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h68oj1c9h2bs) Thank you for your support! For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044

I’m personally reaching out to share why tonight’s FEC deadline matters so much to our success.
#

Hi friend -
I’m personally reaching out today to share a bit about the kind of campaign we need to run to win North Carolina and why tonight’s FEC deadline matters so much to our success.
The typical kind of Senate campaign we’ve seen in North Carolina hasn’t worked for Democrats frankly. That’s why I’ve said from day one that we have to try something different.
What I’ve learned from my previous statewide campaigns is that we really need leaders who focus on the people they serve. We must speak to the hopes and needs of every North Carolinian — particularly those who have been left behind and ignored by Washington for so long.
And in a tough race like this, we will need to build the largest grassroots movement our state has ever seen to mobilize voters everywhere. Reporting a strong number after tonight’s deadline will send a powerful message that we have what it takes to do just that.
[**So can you make a $3 donation to our campaign before our FEC deadline at midnight? I cannot win this race for U.S. Senate alone. It will require all of us to come together as part of this bottom-up, grassroots effort.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36762067/309117812/1741212721?refcode2=a8405204-1322-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&refcode=em210930-1-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDMyNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODQwNTIwNC0xMzIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UtsPsjUdS__bCuauweaSZ-9TBOxoXBbhSBmhVHMb5r4=)

* Exposing "under the radar screen" use of taxpayer funds to indoctrinate our military and American schoolchildren in Marxist, racist **Critical Race Theory** and **Black Lives Matte** r propaganda.

* Uncovering evidence of the **corrupt family business schemes involving China, Ukraine and Russia by Hunter Biden** - schemes that implicate **Joe Biden**.

We are proud to announce two more endorsements of principled, fighting, American First conservatives running to take back the Ho
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsr6gqg9os6hmth0ns5hevt3gcfd9d8nqtcvldt0_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h6cp72c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onlmtgjcsr0m8oe0p75edim9ork61on0sj7m1q68o37m8rj2c71e6qn2dr46tg71puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg75cr66hgb6phgeth6cd70m9h3csh5u)
_Anna Paulina Luna, Candidate for Congress, FL-13_ Fellow Patriot: We are proud to announce two more endorsements of principled, fighting, American First conservatives running to take back the House of Representatives next year. First, HFF endorses **Anna Paulina Luna** for Congress in Florida’s 13th District. This will be an open seat in the 2022 elections, so the path is wide open for a great conservative candidate to win. And GREAT is the only word to describe Anna. She is a warrior, literally. She grew up in some of the roughest neighborhoods in Los Angeles – and fought her way out by enlisting in the Air Force after high school. She learned conservative values the hard way – by watching what government dependency, illegal immigration, and lawlessness did to her community. Anna embodies the American Dream, which is why she has been endorsed by President Donald Trump. | |
---
**_"Anna is a warrior, she is a winner, and it's time for all America First Republicans to unite behind her strong campaign." – President Donald J. Trump_**
|
---
**[Please support Anna Paulina Luna today!](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zrbicpvlrus0te2p9q0k8f39vdkj9gthlvhq5fk8_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h6cp72c9h2bs)**

You may already know Anna from her work with Turning Point USA as a tireless advocate for conservative principles and policy. She and her husband, Andy, a fellow veteran who won a Purple Heart in Afghanistan, work with non-profits serving the veteran community.

As you may remember, Anna came up just short in this district in 2020 up against a corporate-backed incumbent. He doesn’t want a rematch, so next year Florida’s 13th District will be an open seat – and conservatives around the country are rallying to Anna’s side.

**[Please help send Anna Paulina Luna to Congress now!](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zn93r97hd5gbg1fn7ogu6eqnr64hjie0upaj6elo_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h6cp72c9h2bs)**
|
---

_Eric Burlison, Candidate for Congress, MO-07_
We are also proud to endorse **Eric Burlison** for Congress in Missouri’s 7th District.

Eric is a Missouri state Senator with the #1 most conservative voting record in the state legislature. He has fought woke socialists in his state, and now he’s ready to take the fight to Congress.

Eric is not just a true America First conservative. He’s also a proven leader. The Left has hit him with everything they’ve got for years – and he’s still fighting back, on the issues that matter most: election integrity, the right to life, border security, and our constitutional rights.

He won’t crack under pressure. Instead, he will apply much-needed pressure against Nancy Pelosi, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris.

**[Please support Eric Burlison for Congress today!](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zssiob2eljnkgjv6idtrfjvanl566l8v5f84mugo_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h6cp72c9h2bs)**

Eric and Anna now join our other priority House candidates:

✅ U.S. Rep. Yvette Harrell (NM-02)
✅ U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert (CO-03)
✅ U.S. Rep. Scott Perry (PA-10)

With your help, they will all join Jim Jordan, Byron Donalds, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Andy Biggs, and the rest of the House Freedom Caucus in the fight for America's future next year.

**[Please join us in supporting them now. Help Anna, Eric, and the rest of our priority candidates today!](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ztp537592es04pmtas0nl3bnjtko08fv139ua5u0_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h6cp72c9h2bs)**

Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help us promote principled leadership in Washington.

Sincerely,
Ray Yonkura
Executive Director
House Freedom Fund
|

Fellow Conservative,

I know that you’ve seen my name a lot in your inbox this past month - I hope that you know the only reason I’m emailing with the frequency that I am is because **the race for Virginia’s 7th district is going to cost millions of dollars when all is said and done**. Quite frankly, _this is going to be the race which determines whether control of the House flips to the Republican Party_.

I received an email from my opponent last night - who, by the way has started emailing three to four times per week recently - in which her team admits they’re preparing for spending in 2022 to be higher than in 2020 when outside groups spent over **$15 million**.

With the increased frequency of fundraising emails on my opponent’s behalf, I know that we’re going to be up against a very formidable opponent.

You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj5nekbmqao046eokgu6s7i9ciijnqfc2jpruq28_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1h62p70chh2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

name: John Fetterman
subject: I realize my team and I have been sending you a lot of emails lately, so I want to take a moment to explain why your support is so crucial:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Basically, the momentum of our campaign is about to become public.
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20210930-2828-header&t=1&akid=2828%2E434096%2EMkcaKD)
Peter,
I'm coming to you today to ask if you'll please kick in [** _your first-ever $5 donation to our campaign to flip this Pennsylvania Senate seat before the FEC deadline tonight at 11:59 p.m. ET._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30712?refcode=em20210930-2828&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=2828%2E434096%2EMkcaKD)
That said, I think my team and I owe you an explanation. Some context, if you will:
Every quarter, campaigns like ours are legally required to report out all our latest fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission. **Basically, the momentum of our campaign becomes public.**
So, as you might expect, reporters will be scouring these numbers — as will our opponents, including Donald Trump's handpicked candidate on the GOP side. Honesty, putting up a huge number at the conclusion of this quarter's deadline tonight is the single biggest test our campaign has faced since we launched way back in February.
**Peter, not only do we need to *look* like a strong campaign — we really need to raise the funds to build the kind of giant, inclusive field organizing operation that can reach every single voter in every single one of PA's 67 counties.**[**_We've still got a ways to go so, if you can afford it, I am asking you to please make a $5 donation directly to our campaign before midnight to help reach our really important goal._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30712?refcode=em20210930-2828&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=2828%2E434096%2EMkcaKD)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30712?refcode=em20210930-2828&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=2828%2E434096%2EMkcaKD)**
It's not lost on me that you get a lot of requests from my team and me.
I know they can sometimes start to pile up.
But the reality is that, if we want to continue being *the* winning grassroots campaign in a crowded race for the #1 Most Likely to Flip Senate seat of 2022, then we MUST raise as much money as possible before our Q3 FEC deadline happening tonight at midnight.
But here's what I know (and what I hope you know too, Peter): We absolutely have the team out there to make it happen. We're doing this the right way, no corporate PACs allowed. Just working people from Cresco and all across Pennsylvania.
**The only way we can win is with lots of online donations today — big or small — from people like you.** [** _I've gotta ask: Will you donate your first $5 ahead of tonight's FEC deadline? It'd really make all the difference in this fight._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30712?refcode=em20210930-2828&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=2828%2E434096%2EMkcaKD)
Thank you for everything. I'll reach back out soon.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

subject: Peter, how are you?

body:
| | Peter, how's your Thursday? It's another fundraising deadline for my campaign today ... these deadlines are always a bit stressful and this quarter's report is likely the most important one of my career. This third-quarter fundraising report is going to show Republicans exactly where we stand after they spent over $200k in attack ads against us and a poll has us down 7 points. If we submit a fundraising report that shows weakness, they will attack us even more than they already have. Definitely not what we want. I keep checking ActBlue to see how many donations are coming through, and unfortunately we're not where we need to be. As you know, I refuse to take corporate PAC money. That certainly makes it harder to fundraise, but I think it's important to show I'm fighting for the people, not corporations or special interests. That's why, with only 12 hours to go until the deadline, I'm turning to you and personally asking, Peter: Will you make a donation of any amount to my campaign so we can hit our goal and fight back against the GOP's attempts to flip this seat? I'm dropping my personal donation link here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-10-Email-Sept2021-FR-EOQ?refcode=Peter**](https://act.myngp.com/el/Ke6W0V5jnPC3jQVpnky12rSuD_lYy7gzxlBU6AZZ4_s=/PwnbYDxDSc3jMAByfE__M1xA8EjgAvBmHZjfz7WSUrQ=?refcode=E11616-20210930-FinalEOQ1-SL-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15&refcode2=b) I'd be incredibly grateful to see your donation come through before 9:00 pm PST. **
NBC NEWS: DEMOCRATS ' HOUSE MAJORITY IS IN JEOPARDY**
I'm in complete disbelief.

NBC just announced my House Majority is in severe danger.

Republicans only need to flip FIVE seats to regain the Majority.

And I just watched them launch a massive wave of attack ads against ELEVEN of my most vulnerable Democrats.

[**I refuse to let Republicans attack my Democrats and unseat our critical Majority. I can fix this, but not if we fail to meet my critical End of Quarter goal before my deadline in just 15 hours. Can I count on your help right now to protect our House Majority? >>**](https://links.e.dccc.)

Republicans have posted record-breaking fundraising SIX months in a row.

Trump's shady political groups have $102 MILLION in the bank.

And we're on the brink of falling short of my MASSIVE End of Quarter goal.

name: David Horowitz
subject: Betrayal
body:
Peter, The greatest threat to our military right now isn't Russia or China. It's Washington D.C. _It 's the America-hating politicians subverting our armed forces with divisive propaganda._ It's **Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin** -- restructuring the Pentagon's training to revolve around the doctrines and false history of Critical Race Theory and the 1619 Project. It's **Bishop Garrison** -- hand selected by Secretary Austin to lead the military's purge of conservatives, Trump supporters and patriots like you and me. It's **Admiral Michael Gilday** -- pitting white sailors against nonwhite sailors, citing the works of America-hating Marxist Ibram X. Kendi. It's **General Mark Milley** -- who sided with violent Black Lives Matter terrorists that torched our cities to the ground, bowing to the Critical Race Theory dogma to keep his job when Biden took office. It's Air Force Chief of Staff **Charles Q. Brown Jr**. (a leading candidate to replace General Milley) -- betraying his own country and branch of the military as its top enlisted leader. And it's every last bureaucrat that appointed them, nominated them or enabled them. [**And that 's why I hope I can count on your support of the Freedom Center as we exhaust every resource at our disposal to save our military, and remove the military officials working in direct opposition to our nation's values and interests.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r) My name is David Horowitz, and when I was a young man, I dreamt of a day when our leaders embraced this backwards ideology -- because when I was a young man, I was a full fledged communist. I was side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited Ramparts - the largest magazine of the radical Left. I marched, I wrote manifestos, and I attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam, and my eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan and never looked back. I created the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left, and dedicated my life to exposing them, and revealing what I knew about them to the rest of the world. **And I can tell you beyond a shadow of a doubt that critical race theory is just Marxism by a new name, and any military official promoting it is a threat to our republic.** With your help, we can cut through this administration's lies and their media lapdogs' propaganda -- and tell the truth to the American people about what's happening to our military on _OUR_ dime. **[Will you donate $25 or more to the Freedom Center](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r),** and give us the ammunition we need to publish and distribute two original pamphlets explaining what's happening to our country in detail, petition for the removal of treacherous leaders, and so much more? These hacks are doing our enemies' work for them, and destroying our military from the inside out. They're sending a loud clear message to the world that the United States isn't united at all, but divided by race and more vulnerable than ever. **My Freedom Center has stood proudly behind our military for over 30 years --_and that 's exactly why we're taking on their new woke leadership._** Because the twisted ideologies Joe Biden's military leadership is pushing on our men and women in uniform is putting them -- and our country -- in immense danger. [**But as a nonprofit organization, we won 't succeed without patriots like you by our side.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r) This administration and everyone associated with it projects weakness, fragility and cowardice, and our enemies are circling like vultures. Without a strong military, we're at the mercy of our adversaries. Without a strong military, there is no America. And without America, there is no hope. _" If we lose freedom here, there is no place to escape to. This is the last stand on earth." _ _\-- Ronald Reagan_ I hope I can count on your generous support today. Sincerely, [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r) David Horowitz [**SUPPORT THE FREEDOM CENTER**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442744:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r) The David Horowitz Freedom Center is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
All donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. **[Support the Freedom Center](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/58442743:6tAVwo2N2:m:1:3253819041:A7707B4DCE8C844DF62D1843FC8B7EE5:r)** (C) David Horowitz Freedom Center | www.HorowitzFreedomCenter.org

What’s next for NextGen

| | Friend, **Today, I’m excited to announce that NextGen America is officially launching the largest youth voter-mobilization program in America for the 2022 election cycle.** Across Texas, Arizona, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, Michigan, Wisconsin, Nevada, and beyond, we aim to register over 288,000 voters between the ages of 18 and 35 and reach out to over 9 million young people. We are as excited as we are confident that we will meet this moment and mobilize young voters from every corner of this country. But we can’t do it without your help. [Here’s our first ask of the cycle: Will you pledge to vote in your upcoming state election?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/36773806/309143782/1097673176?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTdkOGY5YS0yMDIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=insrYBRcHyDVmp7bw7Ce648mQD04NQRt2zasmt8BOKI=&emci=51953f68-851d-ec11-981f-0050f271a1a2&emdi=d97d8f9a-2022-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&ceid=6787172) We’re kicking off our new program this weekend in Texas, but we’re only getting started. NextGen will hold additional launch events in Arizona, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania in October and November. Throughout September and October, NextGen is sending voter-registration mail to nearly 100,000 young voters and texting and calling 1.4 million more. From February through August of this year, NextGen contacted more than 1.5 million young people. **Now that you’re in the loop, we’re going full speed ahead.** In this coming election, so much will be on the line: confronting climate change, saving our democracy, tackling grotesque income inequality — and that’s just the beginning of the list. We know young people have the power to deliver a resounding message to the politicians trying to take our country backwards — **if they want to cling to the past they can have it, but the future belongs to us.** [Our journey starts with your pledge to vote.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/36773808/309143784/-468410765?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTdkOGY5YS0yMDIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=insrYBRcHyDVmp7bw7Ce648mQD04NQRt2zasmt8BOKI=&emci=51953f68-851d-ec11-981f-0050f271a1a2&emdi=d97d8f9a-2022-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&ceid=6787172) | [Pledge to vote now](https://click.everyaction.com/k/36773813/309143786/-2034494706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTdkOGY5YS0yMDIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=insrYBRcHyDVmp7bw7Ce648mQD04NQRt2zasmt8BOKI=&emci=51953f68-851d-ec11-981f-0050f271a1a2&emdi=d97d8f9a-2022-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&ceid=6787172 "Sign up to text")

body:
News from Erik Aadland
---
| | | | | | Volume 10 | September 29 2021
---
|
---
| A Word From Erik
---
| Chaos. That's the word that best describes the situation in Del Rio, Texas, where 15,000 Haitian migrants have crossed the border and set up camp. By failing to enforce immigration laws and end illegal crossings, Joe Biden continues to allow dangerous conditions to threaten the safety and protection of our nation and its citizens. Meanwhile, Michael Bennet turns a blind eye to the crisis.
And another crisis is brewing in D.C. as Democrats are moving to raise the nation's debt ceiling. It's like a credit card company that keeps raising the limit on a bunch of teenagers who spend like there is no tomorrow. What does that mean to you? As the debt spins out of control, you will feel the impact at the grocery store. Inflation will continue to rise to disastrous levels, taking its toll on every American. Add to it a $3.5 trillion infrastructure spending spree, the majority of which doesn't go to infrastructure. You deserve to keep more of your hard-earned money, and I will see to it that the government stops writing checks you can't cash.
Finally, in a Democrat-controlled, one-party-rule in Washington, Michael Bennet and John Hickenlooper failed Colorado once again. The headquarters for the Bureau of Land Management will head back to Washington rather than being located in Grand Junction. Exactly what are Bennet and Hickenlooper doing for Colorado?
Despite this, I offer you hope, as Coloradans are rising up and demanding more. As your U.S. Senator I will fight for immigration laws to be enforced, protecting our nation and its people from foreign invasion. I will demand accountability in government spending. And I will fight for Colorado each and every day I serve in the Senate.
It's time for change. Join me in the fight to bring sensibility back to the Senate.
Erik

| Campaign Update
---

|
Erik has been traveling all over the state of Colorado to meet people who are tired of politics and want real answers.
In September, he has traveled from Eagle to Weld County and down to Canon City. Erik spoke to the state Republican Party in Pueblo about establishing unity within the party.

Erik has just returned from a successful fundraising visit to Texas where he met with other liberty-loving supporters who want to see the Republican party take back the U.S. Senate.
Finally, Erik will travel to La Plata County on Oct. 2 for their Lincoln Day Dinner.

We are excited to see the grassroots support of Erik grow as he shares his solutions for the many issues we face today.

Tonight, is an important deadline for fundraising, and the Democrats are amassing a huge campaign war chest. We want Michael Bennet and the Democrats to know we intend to take this U.S. Senate seat and stand up to tyranny.
Please join our cause and donate by midnight, Sept. 30, to demonstrate your support for freedom.

Friends,

Growing up in a small town in Ohio, no one had to tell me that neighbors
should take care of neighbors.

I saw it in action every single day. I watched my grandmother bring folks
soup when they were sick, and my grandfather go door to door collecting
donations whenever someone was having a hard time. Church festivals,
Little League games, union meetings -- our community felt like one big
family.

That’s the way it should be in this country. That’s the kind of spirit
that makes this country truly great.

But right now, we have too many leaders who don’t believe in looking out
for each other. We have too many leaders willing to bow down to special
interests and giant corporations while places like my hometown are left
behind.

I’m running for Senate because it’s time for a Washington that puts the
needs of workers and families first. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4958?t=1007&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]If you’re with me, I’m asking you
to chip in.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4958?t=1008&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]Donate $25 [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4959?t=1009&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]Donate $50 [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4960?t=1010&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]Donate $100 [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4961?t=1011&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]Donate $200

In today’s economy, American workers are competing with people around the
world for jobs. So in my mind, there’s nothing more patriotic than
investing in our people.

I’m not talking about handouts. I’m talking about being given a fair shot.

We can invest in our small businesses. We can create millions of
good-paying, green jobs. We can build things here again.

My kids and your kids deserve an America where they’re able to succeed --
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/4958?t=1012&akid=1022%2E3611125%2EskT8z6 ]will you chip in $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can to help us build
the grassroots momentum we need to make it happen?

**Democrats run the Inner Cities of America. There are no ifs, ands, or buts about it.** For the better part of a century, Democrats have solely controlled what happens in every major city in America, and yet every single one of these places is still struggling.

**If Democrats care so much for “Communities of Color” and the “working class” why is it that these same people in the inner cities have only seen an increase to the violence, poverty, and inequality that plagues their communities?**

If no one else is going to say it, then I will; Democrats don’t care about “working class” people or the “Communities of Color” they claim to represent. [**If you want to expose this truth as I do, then help this organization reach out to those communities.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=9c18ddd7b9de47a386afa563fa9f37d4&_e=F0f_gNaJJQPXY7j87j7tgK-HtTBIngoPW97TKVOLQNDysc3dTUriuGHOOh1-zWOLg3ECqGqQi-rqAkX1TaF51T65NzvyAyxV2q6SWefoVkai-gkE6vW963yqg-t2JjdxxUXwO5X3NaaBxA9hDJTERFALEB1RDy5XFEGmlBjw0FDj45_BmYEhdJ72Ggje1rIjMHzhbbjzvSaCHqQZ5uAmqTuT4aRuLy7dn_OKTQYuyK38dK6694mswvH12Y5Kh-SHs6C-u5IXyf8KwWOC4LSrjuZJ9OQ6MLTQ8e8GLy5k_oGwv5_EzjQhOhuZdrbm5oMGGq6YFAO2R7PCuslbscnVbSnGsfEboqKfeR8rGzC618XCT6YDX82hocg-Hj79euxKPoG8UqQohVQpymn8Fyf4-WTfUgJV5IyJcyAna2C1t47xpLLbTfn8RTjrecHP2P0j02zb27TiMNz1RJCtir9VwTOUAsA6SJw8deFtT4FZENg%3D) It’s time we make them Republican again and stop letting the Democrats destroy these communities with their policies.

[** Make Black and Brown Americans Republican Again **](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=9c18ddd7b9de47a386afa563fa9f37d4&_e=F0f_gNaJJQPXY7j87j7tgK-HtTBIngoPW97TKVOLQNDysc3dTUriuGHOOh1-zWOLg3ECqGqQi-rqAkX1TaF51T65NzvyAyxV2q6SWefoVkai-gkE6vW963yqg-t2JjdxxUXwO5X3NaaBxA9hDJTERFALEB1RDy5XFEGmlBjw0FDj45_BmYEhdJ72Ggje1rIjMHzhbbjzvSaCHqQZ5uAmqTuT4aRuLy7dn_OKTQYuyK38dK6694mswvH12Y5Kh-SHU4yCo2nTDqJjaal591uCtPmlaPvtUD7B0oLr4x7lGcpyxZQ-j0jYcGU5OBOVbTtgUjxRVmmLXoTMNKTewsTD8zcF4bqZARgxKFCvVZAIlqlPm6TWsXthXfBRJSZayKohwL1w490j2MCE8XYgi-EcmL_pGTci7ODXVSYFoE2He9koD5eT4B_UuqomcsFlZbdYgunebzaurWHonFr9LK_dEZX5qPAOBbTeOob4Zbiq9ek%3D)
**Donald Trump had one of the largest minority vote shares among Conservative Presidents in over 40 years.** We need to capitalize on that and make sure the Red Wave next year is a Tsunami in response to the chaos that Democrats have caused.

We’re hosting community events, outreach opportunities, and face-to-face meetings with the very communities that were Republican barely 100 years ago. | | Team — Susie emailed you.
Congressman Steven Horsford emailed you.
Senator Cory Booker emailed you.
Senator Jacky Rosen emailed you. _**Now I’m emailing you one last time!**_ **Everyone is pitching in to help Susie reach this crucial end-of-quarter goal and DEFEND NV-03.** Folks, I’m reaching out because we urgently need your help. | | | [RUSH $15 >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36801433/309172474/-2054270566?refcode=EM_BS_LEE_210930_FR_EOQ13_A0_NA_X1_M2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjA5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMWU5ODE2My0zMTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XQJnyno1k8Dj6e4EYh548gFejYtJStiu6IsSL5Uqxt0=)
---
We’ve had some of Susie’s biggest supporters email you — _including Susie herself_ — about why **it’s crucial we hit our $50,000 goal to keep this district blue.** But, we just haven’t seen the response that we expected.

body:
There's one group that's particularly fired up to see LaMalfa gone. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36801813/309173277/390307162?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTc0ZmRiMS0zMTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z03Nu4zgcWTrSVgUOdAoKSN3dElR-Yz1AIYTtcQlpLo=)
Hi friend! 👋 Zane here, Max's campaign manager.

In just a moment, I'm going to ask you for a $3 contribution to close out our first FEC fundraising deadline. But first, let me share some exciting news with you:

We know that a ton of people in the North State are fed up with our opponent, far-right seditionist LaMalfa, but there's one group that's particularly fired up to see him gone: **college students and young people.**

That makes sense because LaMalfa's an embarrassment with no legislative accomplishments to speak of. And he's been a disaster on education, solving our climate crisis, and a ton of other issues that matter to young folks.

Our challenge is making sure they know Max is the viable Democrat running to replace him. It's a myth that students and young people are apathetic and don't vote, but we still have to reach them where they're at.

name: Self Reliance Central
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
This sponsored message from Self Reliance Central is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zph7l6529lvop66u721mkdncu2l83jdhc1cena1o_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1j6aor4c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2ztdl22j4reetpifiete8q6m9eqnhb6s49ipiarho_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1j6aor4c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zjj2p5f2jovk9snr5ggmqprsdahauql2a064o6t8_rp22sh2s8i66pj6c1j6aor4c3h2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

Everyone is in one of three categories -- which one are you? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36803376/309178832/-2037180865?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmI1ZGU5MS0zNTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pQerRMMM5NhaMLSnrBqqAB0qa0_Dd_vtrhjRU9Gi_3w=&emci=63e2e980-a620-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&emdi=86b5de91-3522-ec11-981f-501ac510a405&ceid=12898431)

Friend,

Did you see our last email? If not, here’s what you missed: we’re 97% to our goal for the quarter. That’s the good news.

The bad news is that we’re in what’s called a “frontline” or highly competitive district, and that quarterly goal is huge. It has to be. So, while 97% sounds great, **we’re still a few thousand dollars short.**

This is where you come in. If you’re reading this email you fall into one of three categories:
**1\. You haven’t yet made up your mind about the race.** I’ll be blunt: Kirsten is the most experienced candidate, has the most support from elected officials and organizations, and most importantly, has the most grassroots supporters (like you) backing her. This is a _very_ competitive seat, and we _must_ put forward the candidate that gives Democrats **the best chance to win** and maintain our majority in Congress. That candidate is without question Kirsten Engel.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36803377/309178833/41694283?refcode=X_093021_EOQ_N&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmI1ZGU5MS0zNTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pQerRMMM5NhaMLSnrBqqAB0qa0_Dd_vtrhjRU9Gi_3w=)
---

**2\. You support Kirsten but haven’t yet contributed.** You might be waiting until the election gets closer. But if you’re reading this email, I’m willing to bet your interest is more than just casual. You’re invested. You want to see the seat stay Democratic and you know Kirsten is the best candidate to do that. And here’s the thing: we’ll have casual supporters contribute next year. But again, forgive my bluntness, we need the money now. We need to hire grassroots organizers, we need to print things like palm cards, petitions, and signs. **We need to get the campaign firing on all cylinders now, so we need people like you, who are the backbone of this campaign, to step up before midnight.**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36803378/309178835/41694283?refcode=X_093021_EOQ_N&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmI1ZGU5MS0zNTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pQerRMMM5NhaMLSnrBqqAB0qa0_Dd_vtrhjRU9Gi_3w=)
---

**3\. You’ve already contributed.** If you’re in this category, please allow me to again say THANK YOU. Your generosity is what fuels this campaign. I don’t have to tell you how important your support is to Kirsten and the team. This is one of the only open seats on the election map this cycle, and we need to have the resources to win. **If you can make an additional contribution before midnight, I know Kirsten would greatly appreciate it. **

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/36803380/309178837/41694283?refcode=X_093021_EOQ_N&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmI1ZGU5MS0zNTIyLWVjMTEtOTgxZi01MDFhYzUxMGE0MDUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pQerRMMM5NhaMLSnrBqqAB0qa0_Dd_vtrhjRU9Gi_3w=)
---

Thank you for your continued support,

Fellow American,

When I think back on the past tumultuous year, I remember how:

Our city burned.

Our families were scared, even in their own homes.

Violent crime surged across our communities.

**_When our country needed real leadership, we were failed._**

So, when my second child was born and I looked into his big curious eyes, I knew I had to run for Congress because our families deserve so much better than a state ran by radical liberals who want to defund our police, open our borders, and destroy the foundation our country was built on.

If we haven’t met yet, I’m Tyler Kistner. A proud father of two, husband, and Marine Raider Veteran. I would do anything for my children, my family, and my country.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=acb9f960a3f84fc58e085ca9e2642883&_e=TqYOpoYfP7klwDTSTpCHv7C3HrNciLzs6rmUtFjD9YtDUDau0hP5p6j6J55LoilYFgFOHEeDB-w-soHANqT9kBKICG_HieNerLLWRb2GB6hHdbGTgaCtlWfktrGiwtBx8RXj2RrqdIyl6gTfVSW0q-a9hrNuIglxn5dv_T8SQeeY0W7ZnKyeholpBwlnJMwOTaz532WOL29LwloXPSL64LCMWqL8QM7EBKbcHp70AUuRFYHg6GUSpSJ7HFl3m9RVeCRjH5zOM6x1X46B8qWxB3UZzXY1tYdPi7YOEGn7THjCVFfWmqpr5ewxOosYiekLSCuD9YrF3PA7CelwQ9h8YZuVtae_9YtQz5Rnt1ID_Dxm0HgWtkO3kVMgrdgOkDE0HqggnT8XGnIyYv71YykU1w%3D%3D)

[** ****Send in the Marine ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=acb9f960a3f84fc58e085ca9e2642883&_e=TqYOpoYfP7klwDTSTpCHv7C3HrNciLzs6rmUtFjD9YtDUDau0hP5p6j6J55LoilYFgFOHEeDB-w-soHANqT9kBKICG_HieNerLLWRb2GB6hHdbGTgaCtlWfktrGiwtBx8RXj2RrqdIyl6gTfVSW0q-a9hrNuIglxn5dv_T8SQechZXp6quLNU4AaN3Qoe1jP3qMeUfvK9vvmE1E2YerhJHU5ujEjZ3ZqaxQXKmK-55gK0FYzTiXZK-hmWxOqN8pqykZIYzXqVyBgQmJB15voIy0W840QzvJTCLodnyIHoWboD03VQw4VbcnBTyu4xMvLmDj1uVZ_QVQoTflH6wDKF8zjA8OXo3b51iEjOjOdpxbhZZSu-VUZsjb9nsTIF8or38Wq-nHw1w39NYgE3Hxk5g%3D%3D)

My children deserve a shot at the America dream, and so do yours. _But the path we are on right now, is horrifying._

I served nine years in the U.S. Marine Corps, for five of those years I served in the elite Marine Special Operation Forces - the Marine Raiders. I took an oath to defend our Constitution, and my oath to this country will never expire. [**I want to fix the broken system in Washington, so we have a country we are proud to leave for our next generation and that’s what I plan to do in Congress.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=acb9f960a3f84fc58e085ca9e2642883&_e=TqYOpoYfP7klwDTSTpCHv7C3HrNciLzs6rmUtFjD9YtDUDau0hP5p6j6J55LoilYFgFOHEeDB-w-soHANqT9kBKICG_HieNerLLWRb2GB6hHdbGTgaCtlWfktrGiwtBx8RXj2RrqdIyl6gTfVSW0q-a9hrNuIglxn5dv_T8SQediYxjjVGOyPspQUDtN9viqt7FklN-vgGJKo-SdSw4hwwlaigaaxk7AmNvbCvVqHvsV1cw9M-XR97bTlbuA2JyF1V0GYagB0zZMu4zLFP4QmFaqqJOuGmJIdpwu7v9FJE0xQ3_43IjeccdT0zXqUd-hbSIi9N4Ddg956hjYkRWnkZ7wuCNuK0sc-q-qliu2uEfFdRtMwpjzjZAUsjJFZaGDxktKudQK-ZpT1lZhu9QpGQ%3D%3D)

When I ran last year, we had one of the closest races in the country. I fell short by less than 10,000 votes. But this year, all eyes are on this seat. It’s one of the top races in the country because Republicans only need to net FIVE seats to regain our majority and take the country back from the intolerant and radical Left.

I’m running for Congress in Minnesota’s 2nd district because the current 'leaders' have sold out our children’s future to the radicals who wish to destroy the American dream. Let’s take our country back.

body:
To be honest — I *really* wanted to give these signs out to all of yinz for free. But a $10 donation is about as close as we can get.
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20210930-2842-header&t=1&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)
To be honest — I *really* wanted to give these signs out to all of yinz for free.
Our finance team made it really clear that we had to at least break even 🙄 — after all, at the time in 2016, the race to flip this Senate seat was the most expensive Senate race in history.
**So this is about as close as we can get. For just $10, we’ll print and ship a union-made yard sign straight to your door. But there’s just one catch: You’re running out of time, Peter. **
Tonight, our campaign is required by federal law to publicly report exactly how much we’ve raised this quarter to the FEC. That makes this evening one of the most important of our campaign, as our team works around-the-clock to demonstrate the power of this movement that that you could help us build with your first donation, Peter.
So, here’s my ask to you: [**Will you kick in $10 or more using this link for an official Team Fetterman yard sign? Plus, here's the *really* fun part: If you're in Pennsylvania, Gisele and I might just hand-deliver your yard sign straight to you.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30248?refcode=em20210930-2842&t=2&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)
[****](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30248?refcode=em20210930-2842&t=3&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)
[**Donate $10 or more using this link, and we'll send you an official Team Fetterman yard sign. If you're in Pennsylvania, Gisele and I may just show up at your door to deliver your sign by hand. Our team will compile a list of every Pennsylvanian who donates to get their sign, and we'll make it a point to hand-deliver yard signs to a few of yinz.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30248?refcode=em20210930-2842&t=4&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)
**[Get Your Yard Sign →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/30248?refcode=em20210930-2842&t=5&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)**
And when you get your sign, we can’t wait to see where it ends up! Send us a photo of where you’re rocking your sign. Maybe I’ll get to see it myself sometime!
In gratitude,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20210930-2842-footer&t=6&refcode2=2842_434096__Tm7Oc&akid=2842%2E434096%2E_Tm7Oc)**

body:
Peter,

It's ridiculous, isn't it?

But it's necessary. Why? Because corporate PACs, Super PACs, and other dark money groups [**spent an average of $3,000,000**](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=) opposing each of our veteran and military family candidates of integrity for Congress last November.

Regular people of good character just can't compete with that on their own. [_**That 's why we need you.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=)

Taking the Hill funds the kinds of candidates you want in public office - those who have proven their integrity over years of service to our country. We'll break down the math for you:

* We are endorsing 22 candidates for the US House and Senate in 2022, and we want to help them each reach at least 10,000 veteran and military family voters in their districts. In total, that's more than 200,000 voters.
* Whether it's door-to-door, in their mailbox, or on TV, [_**the average cost of voter contact across all mediums last cycle was ~$5 per voter.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=) That means that, between now and next November, we need to raise more than $1 million to win - or roughly $75,000 per month.
* We're coming to you because [_**we need to raise another $8,000 today to hit that target**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=) \- and keep our good, decent, and honorable candidates on the path to victory.

[_**If every person reading this chips in to help us reach 10 voters today (that 's just $50!) by clicking here,**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=) we will exceed our goal and be able to go up on the airwaves and help volunteers canvas for our candidates. That's huge! [_**As a BONUS, anyone who helps us reach more than 200 voters (by contributing $1,000 or more) will get FREE admission to the rest of our political events this year.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZElqZAcdItbRHoH9LYRwR9V58ApOWSPiIaqx949e2LQ=/BloRWgytvwSiuEtC7BQ7iB2w_4YhRAgjN1_-gMLObNw=) Previous guests have included Cory Booker, Tammy Duckworth, and Raphael Warnock - you don't want to miss them!

Thank you for opening this email and understanding why we write to you! We hope we're making you proud.

Yours in service,
Roger

body:
Invest in the people, fight climate change, tax corporations.
#
Peter,
People across this country want economic relief and urgent action to address climate change, and they want corporations to finally pay for it. **That’s why I’m leading the charge to guarantee Democrats pass the President’s Build Back Better Act.**
For far too long, conservatives have let corporate America write the laws that allow fossil fuel companies to destroy our environment, Big Pharma to profit while people ration insulin, and Wall Street to hit it big while hunger and homelessness increase in America.
**That’s why progressives are flexing our muscle on Capitol Hill — the people demand it and deserve it.** We are withholding our votes on a small bill until Democrats pass President Biden’s Build Back Better Act to expand Medicare, secure universal child care, pre-K, and community college, fight climate change, and invest in affordable housing.
[**I won’t give in to the demands of conservatives or corporate America, because I work for the people. If you’re with me in this fight, and want to see Democrats pass the historic Build Back Better Act, please chip in to fuel my work.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/7233?refcode=em20210930-677&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=677%2E420207%2E648cj5) _The end-of-quarter FEC deadline is at midnight, your support before then would mean so much._

The Build Back Better Act is not some fringe list of policy priorities. The conservative Democrats who oppose paid leave, child care, pre-K, climate action, lowering prescription drug prices, and Medicare expansion oppose what the people of this country want. It’s no coincidence that those few people who are opposing these policies take huge sums of campaign money from corporate PACs, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel companies.
Progressives are fighting to keep our promise to those who delivered us the House, the Senate, and the White House during the last election. That’s what they sent us here to do, and we won’t stop fighting for them.
[**No matter what conservatives, Big Pharma, and corporate America try to throw at us, we’re holding the line and delivering. Chip in $3 to fuel my work to finally pass this bill and deliver on our promises to the people.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/7233?refcode=em20210930-677&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=677%2E420207%2E648cj5)
Let’s get this done,

Pramila

clean_body: Help us beat Kevin McCarthy, Madison Cawthorn, and Jim Jordan. | | | Folks, If I asked you to think of some of the worst Republicans in Congress, Kevin McCarthy, Madison Cawthorn, and Jim Jordan would certainly be near the top. This year, they will all have something else in common: They’re going to lose their seats to veterans. Jim Jordan was one of Donald Trump’s favorite mouthpieces in Congress, Madison Cawthorn is proof that the next generation of GOP leaders is going to be just as bad -- if not worse -- than what we already have, and Kevin McCarthy... don’t get me started about Kevin McCarthy. We all want to see these guys lose in 2022, and today, we’re giving you the chance to split a donation between my campaign and the campaigns of Josh Remillard and Jeff Sites -- two veterans running against the rest of the Insurrectionist Caucus. Josh and Jeff are both Army veterans running against some of the worst the GOP has to offer. Just like me, they’re facing a crucial FEC filing deadline tonight , so we thought we would join forces to bring in as much money as possible to defeat our far-right opponents. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately. I’m counting on you, Bruno Amato | | ---|--- Paid for by Bruno Amato for Congress PO BOX 22472 BAKERSFIELD, CA 93390

It’s time to build on what’s working to deliver paid family and medical leave benefits for all workers. Sincerely, The PEF Family | | | | | ---|---|--- |

**The Texas GOP just released their first draft of new congressional maps and it's exactly what we expected -- a Democratic-leaning district in the Austin area where I'm running.**

We've been anticipating this news for a very long time. I've been laying the groundwork to run in this district since we knocked 50,000 doors in TX-31 last year. **Democrats run the Inner Cities of America. There are no ifs, ands, or buts about it.** For the better part of a century, Democrats have solely controlled what happens in every major city in America, and yet every single one of these places is still struggling.

body:

Fellow American,

Never believe the Left’s narrative that America is a racist country; that the American dream doesn’t exist anymore; or that the Constitution is a relic of the past that disproportionately benefits Anglo Americans.

I’m speaking with authority on the matter: **I’m a first generation Haitian-American whose parents came to this country, quite literally penniless, to pick crops in South Florida during the 1980s**. Now, less than forty years after my parents experienced food insecurity and homelessness, I’m running for Congress – as a Republican. **I guess you could say that I don’t fit the Left’s definition of a conservative**.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=137062b0f0f3421bb851073321a2c121&_e=M5_0HlvNxzpwGm9XZxb0kifw7L0osl_uTHuh9mYpEnc_KlE8HaVgC3PZrLYUYmZzm-YrBfFPMtQu99gP2tNAgVH6Cl5iBENaVF2-BUlPA7yBn-BvFLTh-ne9c5gByJ3IP-aR9rCa0Adh1K8nmpPMUfF7eUG9VOQyPMoXGLrs-BSseZJd8h5oLYYYV94tCUwbMboRpKNS1Tj_0hJWK0T6qYlMzgYtwezjkiUOew72lZxFRTgZxkpHyNtEkjeIVfNdkxb99-xUv707t3wxVx5Z6joV1oQhQCjCNqbzgBp1JZw9RMP3LI0HPFxM61puJSTYTVE6bB1GI7rzo2VrCW2RaOXxgWR2a9zxlbIxnl4DZPXJrKckTzQqPyCAKP9XhUcEhhBIgc-p2J5zW3OSh_r09NPcZT3Cc5SX5iK7cXRYO2IWoRmDPlEe5elrEr8f-xVIGpbdvyZbnPLE7fRQWGUSsMz1vCvDby1BCcqLhAdkdaA%3D)
My name is Rod Dorilas and I’d like to tell you a few important things about me and why I’m writing to you today.
* I’m a military veteran (**I joined at 17**),
* I’m a lawyer (**I utilized the GI bill to pay for law school**)
* I’m a former Trump Administration appointee, having held various jobs during the four years President Trump held office.

**The thing I’m most proud about? My family built our own American Dream without the help of the government, or left-wing socialist politicians. And I’m running for Congress because some folks in DC just don’t understand that the government is not going to help make individuals successful – grit, determination and personal responsibility are keys to success.**

body:
This is not the Iowa I know. I'll make this quick, friend.

We've been in touch a lot this week because tonight marks one of the most important tests of our campaign's fundraising strength yet and we're still coming up short. In this email, I'll ask you for $3, but first, let me explain why it's so important.

The stakes in our race have never been higher. I'm traveling across the state, talking with (and listening to!) Iowans of all backgrounds. One thing stands out: **This is not the Iowa I know.**

Sure, nothing has fundamentally changed about the people -- they're still the hard-working, caring folks I've always known. They still like to get out in nature -- whether it's for a hike or hunting -- and they still like to wind down at the end of the day with a beverage and conversation with their friends and family.

**What's changed about Iowa is its leadership at the top -- or lack thereof.** My opponent Kim Reynolds failed to lead this state through the COVID-19 pandemic. Instead, she put our kids and families needlessly at risk to pander to the furthest right-wing of her party.

body:
I wanted you to hear this straight from me.
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20210930-2841-header&t=1&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
Hi Peter — it’s John here.
This evening, you’re hearing from a lot of the campaigns that you support. And there’s a good reason for that. Tonight at midnight, our campaign is required by federal law to publicly report exactly how much we’ve raised this quarter to the FEC.
[**That makes tonight’s deadline at midnight one of the most important nights of our campaign. And in these final hours, I’m here to ask for your support with only one emotion in my and Gisele’s hearts: Gratitude.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=2&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
This campaign has always been about the issues that are impacting families across our Commonwealth. It’s about transparency and faith — **but it’s also deeply rooted in belief. And I’m grateful that you’re here with our team, because it means you believe in what we’re working towards, too.**
[****](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=3&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
I’m grateful to the people across Pennsylvania who have opened their doors and ears to hear about the values that I’m running on to be your 51st Democratic vote in the U.S. Senate.
[**I’m grateful to our supporters who have given what they could, whether it’s $1 or $100, to keep our campaign going strong. I hope today we can count you among them, Peter.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=4&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
[****](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=5&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
I’m grateful for the moments on the trail with Gisele and the kids. Even when I have to round them up in the truck bed to keep ice cream and goldfish out of the truck 🙄.
(Parents get it: That period of time after you get a car and fight to keep it clean with kids before just throwing in the towel. I lasted like 10 days. 🏳️😓)
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=6&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
And I’m beyond grateful for the outpouring of support that we’ve received on this campaign. [**Tonight, for our biggest fundraising deadline yet, I hope you’ll consider making your first donation, of whatever is meaningful to you, to help us cross the finish line.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=7&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)
**[Donate Today →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/32326?refcode=em20210930-2841&t=8&akid=2841%2E434096%2EYe9Rx-)**
See you on the trail!
In gratitude,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

subject: Can I call you?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Erica Smith for US Senate 2022
body:
There are just a few hours left until the FEC deadline and I still need your help.
#
Good evening y'all,
I just finished meeting with my team to go over our finances. With just a few hours left until midnight, we’re _still_ $500 short of our $100,000 online fundraising goal.
[**We need just 3 supporters from your area****to chip in now to help us meet our end-of-quarter fundraising goal. Can you rush a donation to our campaign right now to help close our fundraising gap?**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/18532?t=1&akid=513%2E3698%2E1-mMNq)
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/18665?refcode=em20210930-513&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=513%2E3698%2E1-mMNq)**
**And don’t forget! I’ll give you a call if you donate ANY amount between now and midnight.** I’m serious, I’m calling every single person who donates whether you live in NC or not! So, if you donate, please look out for a North Carolina number ringing your phone sometime soon. 😁
I know you work hard for your money, and I truly appreciate every donation — big or small — from the bottom of my heart.
**Let me tell you more about why tonight’s FEC deadline is BIG.** I promise — it’s important. After tonight, our campaign’s finances become public and you can bet our GOP opponents are going to be taking a long hard look at our numbers.
Not only are our end-of-quarter fundraising numbers a signal of the strength of our moral movement, but they’re going to be a deciding factor on if even MORE opponents jump into this race.
**This moment right here, right now can determine what this race looks like, and if we flip North Carolina blue.**[**We only need 3 supporters from your area to chip in before midnight and we’ll be able to meet our $100,000 goal. Can you be one of them**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/18532?t=21&akid=513%2E3698%2E1-mMNq)[**?**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/18532?t=22&akid=513%2E3698%2E1-mMNq)
Folks are looking for any reason to discount our movement. Now is our moment to prove yes, we CAN win this U.S. Senate race with only the power of small-dollar grassroots donations.
With love,
Erica ❤️
Erica Smith for U.S. Senate

name: Heidi St. John for Congress
subject: Freedom Rallies with Rick Green Wednesday and Thursday!
body:
The future depends on those who show up.
---
| | | | | |
---
| This weekend, I had the privilege of meeting some of our nation's most beloved and fierce defenders of liberty. Their stories and history are inspiring. Once again, I was reminded that freedom is worth fighting for. Liberty is the cause that unites us and it's being threatened by weak Republicans and dangerous Democrats who are drunk with power and who do not value freedom.
Freedom in education, medical freedom, free and fair elections, and a robust return to the Constitution is desperately needed in this hour. The Democrats are using the power they have right now to dismantle this nation, one devastating piece of legislation at a time. We must not stand by and let this continue. Now is our moment to take up the cause of freedom.
It's time to get off the bench and onto the battlefield! I'm willing to fight for the people of Southwest Washington State. I'm willing to lead the charge and leave it all on the field for freedom... are you? It's time to fight for liberty as if our future depends on it--because it does.
These past 17 months have highlighted a truth that we often forget: the future will belong to those who show up. The radical left understands this, and they have been relentless in their push to fundamentally change the nation into the image of those who make a mockery of freedom and the sacrifices that have been made to secure it.
But friends, don't give up. Help is on the way.
This coming week my friend, Rick Green, a Constitution scholar and a fierce defender of liberty will be joining me for for two freedom rallies. I urge you to invite everyone you know and join us as we talk boldly about the issues, offer hope for the future, and chart a course that will steer this nation back to the safe harbor of liberty and away from the clutches of Marxism and Communism. We'll educate, encourage and empower you to get off the sidelines and onto the frontlines. We'll take your questions and fill your hearts with hope. Your voices are necessary in this fight for liberty! Join us and let's work together to defend liberty and secure it for future generations.
For Liberty,
